phase_title: Repository Intelligence Executable Schema Implementation: First Artifact Family
summary: Narrow Track B implementation phase. Implements exactly one first Repository Intelligence artifact-family JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 file: schemas/repository_intelligence/artifacts/contract_conformance_record.schema.json. The Contract Conformance Record schema references verified shared components, includes the common artifact envelope relationship, represents artifact under review, contract basis, invariant checks, named conformance checks, frozen conformance status values, violations, limitations, boundary disclosures, disclaimers, reviewer or verifier identity, and the frozen 119E non-decision disclaimer. Documentation was updated in schemas/repository_intelligence/README.md and docs/PHASE_119_REPOSITORY_INTELLIGENCE_EXECUTABLE_SCHEMA_FIRST_ARTIFACT_FAMILY.md. No additional artifact-family schemas, validators, validation libraries, CLI, automated tests, Python models, Pydantic models, dataclasses, extraction, graph construction, impact engine, Advisory behavior, Evidence, Repository Skills, Decision Evaluation, source code, test code, runtime behavior, execution, enforcement, lifecycle behavior, Permission Broker changes, REST, Dashboard, Web UI, provider orchestration, autonomous coding, automatic patch generation, automatic refactoring, repository mutation outside planned schema/docs files, or Telegram inbound changes.
tests_added_or_updated: None. 119M added one schema artifact and documentation/status memory only.
common_artifact_envelope_relationship: Required envelope property references the verified shared common artifact envelope schema.
artifact_under_review_structure: artifact_id, artifact_reference, artifact_family, artifact_contract_version, schema_concept_version, executable_schema_version, artifact_locator, artifact_digest_or_checksum, and artifact_producer.
contract_basis_structure: Array of contract basis records with contract id, name, version, kind, source locator, and optional source attribution.
conformance_checks_structure: Required invariant checks plus named source attribution, determinism, read-only, decision boundary, Advisory non-authority, execution boundary, uncertainty preservation, conflict preservation, and supersession preservation checks.
individual_check_result_structure: Invariant check results use the frozen invariant values conforms, violation, and unable_to_assess; named checks include result, detail, optional id, name, category, scope, field or section, sources, evidence links, limitations, and notes.
overall_conformance_state_summary: conformance_status uses the frozen 119E vocabulary: conforms, conforms_with_observations, partial_conformance, non_conformance, unable_to_assess.
violation_structure_summary: Violations include invariant_id, violation_description, affected_fields, and optional violation id, violated contract, violated invariant, severity, affected section, source check reference, and human review remediation guidance.
limitation_structure_summary: Root limitations use the verified shared limitation record schema.
boundary_disclosure_summary: Root boundary_disclosures uses the verified shared boundary disclosure schema.
disclaimer_summary: Root disclaimers uses the verified shared disclaimer schema and the schema also requires the frozen Contract Conformance Record non-decision disclaimer.
